nodes.name: Mercy Ledger
nodes.description: Healing you do is written as Mercy: 1 per 8 HP restored, cap 40. Mercy holds while you are in combat and fades outside it. This record is what your strikes hit with.

nodes.name: Mend
nodes.description: Restore an ally. Every point of that heal is written to Mercy.

nodes.name: Debt Lash
nodes.description: A holy strike whose damage rises with the Mercy you have stored. It does not spend the ledger. You hit harder because of the healing you have already done.

nodes.name: Level 5 - Witness
nodes.description: Path node — spend to open Level 5 - Witness.

nodes.name: Witness
nodes.description: Mark one ally for 12 seconds. Heals on that ally write double Mercy. Pick who you are keeping alive.

nodes.name: Unwrite
nodes.description: Strip one harmful effect from an ally. The harm you remove is written as Mercy.

nodes.name: Level 10 - The Account
nodes.description: Path node — spend to open Level 10 - The Account.

nodes.name: Kept Wound
nodes.description: While any ally is under half health, your heals write half again as much Mercy, and Debt Lash hits harder. The hurt ally is the book filling.

nodes.name: Brand
nodes.description: Spend 15 Mercy to brand one enemy for 6 seconds. The brand burns lightly. Rectified and Shared Strike read this mark.

nodes.name: Step to the Hurt
nodes.description: Cross to your most hurt ally and Mend them. That Mend writes Mercy.

nodes.name: Level 15 - Full Book
nodes.description: Path node — spend to open Level 15 - Full Book.

nodes.name: Full Book
nodes.description: At 40 Mercy the ledger stops fading, and Debt Lash and Brand deal more. You feel the book fill.

nodes.name: Shared Strike
nodes.description: For 6 seconds, each ally attack on your Branded enemy heals that attacker. This is the small taste of Rectified. It does not spend the book.

nodes.name: Level 20 - Rectified
nodes.description: Path node — spend to open Level 20 - Rectified.

nodes.name: Rectified
nodes.description: One unleash. Spend all Mercy on one enemy for 8 seconds: a holy burn each second equal to the Mercy spent, split across the mark. Every ally attack on that enemy heals the attacker for one burn tick. You cannot cast it again until the mark ends.

nodes.name: Settled Ledger
nodes.description: When Rectified ends, a quarter of the Mercy you spent comes back, and allies it healed keep a 3 second regen. The unleash does not leave you empty.

specIdentity.name: Mercy Ledger
specIdentity.description: Healing you have done is the damage you can deal. Rectified is the single unleash of that holy power.

priest.role: Healing writes Mercy. Strikes deal damage from that record. Rectified spends the whole book: one holy burn, and allies are healed for attacking that enemy.
